tagline: Getty Realty Corp. is a publicly traded, net lease real estate investment trust (REIT) specializing in the acquisition, financing and development of convenience, automotive and other single tenant retail real estate.
hero_kpi_rationale: AFFO is the primary operating performance indicator for Getty Realty's core business, excluding non-recurring items to reflect sustainable cash generation capacity.

kpis.name: Adjusted Funds From Operations
kpis.explanation: Measures the operating performance of a REIT's core business, excluding non-recurring items.
kpis.description: AFFO is considered the best indicator of Getty Realty's portfolio operating performance, as it excludes items that do not impact recurring cash flow.
kpis.signal: Key measure of REIT operating performance.

kpis.name: Funds From Operations
kpis.explanation: Measures a REIT's operating performance, excluding depreciation and gains/losses on the sale of real estate assets.
kpis.description: FFO is a standard measure of REIT performance, excluding depreciation and gains or losses on the sale of real estate assets.

kpis.name: Net Income

kpis.description: Net income represents the company's final profit after deduction of all charges.

kpis.name: Real Estate Investments

kpis.description: Investments represent the acquisition of new properties and the financing of new developments.
